audit_limitations: Coefficient refits of every unselected candidate
Independent reconstruction of the inherited raw KAHM feature-map implementation
Independent regeneration of all D forecasts from coefficients
A new scientific fit or selection by this auditor
Authentication of the original completed run
Original input or forecast byte identity
descriptive_scope: Unadjusted 95% paired-t intervals; matched RBF is secondary; own B/C choices may differ by target source
rank_scope: Occurrences in independently checked selected geometry banks, not independent tasks or preferred-dimension evidence

reproduction_scope.scope: Four synthetic laws, history 12, horizons 1/4/12 and the frozen finite procedure

review_scope: Independent arithmetic review of already audited results; no refitting or selection

stability.interpretation: Maximum-error screen; does not establish predictive superiority
